featured_reviews.name: BISWAJIT GHOSH
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Extremely Poor & Unprofessional Experience – Not Recommended
I am sharing my genuine experience with BS Auto to help common customers avoid unnecessary stress and loss.
I purchased 7 accessories for my Honda CB350 and prepaid the full amount in advance. Unfortunately, the experience turned out to be extremely disappointing.
My experience highlights:

1. Very unprofessional behavior – No proper coordination, no accountability, and no ownership of issues.

2. Excessive delivery delay – Took 10–20 days for delivery to Kolkata, which is completely unreasonable for paid accessories.

3. Misleading shipment updates – Some products were not shipped, yet the order status was marked as delivered. This created serious confusion and mistrust.
Advance payment taken, items missing – Full payment was collected upfront, but a few products were never delivered.

4. No Proof of Delivery (POD) – Even after repeated requests, POD was not shared on time.

5. Zero customer support – Calls are not answered, and WhatsApp messages and emails are ignored.

5. False assurances – Commitments were made verbally but not honoured.
Poor transparency – No clear information about how many items were shipped, through which courier, or when refunds would be processed.

6.Mentally exhausting follow-ups – Customers are forced to chase continuously for basic information that should be shared proactively.

Overall, the experience felt misleading and unfair to a common customer.

Final verdict:

If you value your money, time, and peace of mind, think twice before ordering from BS Auto. My experience was stressful, disappointing, and far from professional.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the service provided by this dealer.

I tried contacting the dealership multiple times because I needed a spare part for my bike. First, I contacted them through WhatsApp, but instead of getting assistance, I was given another person's number. That person then shared someone else's number, and eventually I was given a staff member's contact number. Unfortunately, that person neither answered my calls nor replied to my WhatsApp messages.

If you do not want to assist customers, at least provide a proper response. I do not understand why contact numbers are listed on Google if nobody is willing to answer customer inquiries.

After receiving no response, I decided to visit the dealership personally. Only then was I informed that the required part was not available and would take about a week to arrive. This information could have easily been shared over WhatsApp or during a phone call, which would have saved me unnecessary time and travel.
Even now, I am not receiving proper updates or responses. As a customer, I should not have to repeatedly visit the dealership just to get basic information about a spare part.

This is not a professional way to handle customers. If you are unable to provide support or respond to inquiries, please do not publish contact details online that customers rely on for assistance.

I hope this issue is taken seriously and that customer service is improved in the future.

Ps. The bike still stalls, changing it back to stock exhaust now

As per the company Performance Racing’s response you must use the exhaust with the baffle(DB Killer) or else the product will work in a faulty way right? I urge you to pass the message to Arrow exhaust manufacturer to please put it up on their official website that their exhausts are meant to work with the DB killer fitted or it wont work.
